title: Multilingual education in unequal contexts: Structural barriers to making all repertoires count in the global south
author: Pramod K. Sah
abstract: This commentary asks what it means to make all repertoires count when languages have unequal social and economic value. It argues that multilingual education requires alignment across policy, curriculum, assessment, institutional power, and material opportunity rather than teacher awareness alone.
relevance: 主线：它直接推进跨国课程与评估公平主线，并连接教材本土化与domain legitimacy这一可信延伸。启发点：文章把recognition与redistribution区分开来，将多语教育的成败从教师态度问题提升为课程、评估、劳动力市场和制度价值是否对齐的问题。可迁移动作：用课程、教材任务、评估和升学就业四层矩阵检查一种语言资源究竟只是被承认、被允许，还是能够正式计分并产生机会。

title: Epistemic (in)justice in English medium instruction: transnational teachers’ and students’ negotiation of knowledge participation through translanguaging
author: Yongyan Zheng, Yixi Qiu
abstract: Informed by translanguaging and epistemic injustice, this 12-month classroom ethnography examines how transnational teachers and students negotiated knowledge participation in an EMI degree programme at a Chinese university. It identifies capacities for counteracting testimonial injustice, supplying hermeneutical resources, and strengthening trans-epistemic sensitivity.
relevance: 主线：它直接推进已发表的EMI跨语实践与身份协商研究，同时连接评估公平中的epistemic injustice问题。启发点：它把笼统的身份协商拆成可观察的知识参与资格，区分谁能贡献知识、谁能提供解释资源以及谁的经验会被承认为证据。可迁移动作：把下一篇EMI研究的问题改写为知识参与链，分别编码知识提出、解释权、他人承接与制度认可。

author: Tomokazu Ishikawa

title: “I Call Them My Little Chinese Kids”: Parents’ Identities and Language Ideologies in a Mandarin-English Dual Language Immersion School
author: May F. Chung
journal: Journal of Culture and Values in Education
abstract: Research on bilingual education presents clear advantages for children’s linguistic, cognitive, and social development. However, recent criticism of dual language education programs has led to claims of dual language education as a marker of elite bilingualism or that parents play their roles as socially accepted “good parents” by sending their child to a bilingual school. relevance: 这篇论文直接对应你今日主线"Teacher vulnerability, dual language immersion, and institutional discourse"中的DLI制度语境，但切入点是家长而非教师。它最值得借鉴的不是主题本身，而是如何将个人话语（家长的身份叙事与语言意识形态表述）提升为结构性分析——即你今天最需要强化的写作能力。论文通过访谈中的意识形态话语揭示DLI项目中隐含的精英双语主义与"好家长"身份建构，这种从个体叙事中抽取制度性权力逻辑的分析路径，可以直接迁移到你的教师脆弱性稿件中：你同样需要把教师的个人经历叙述（"find the guts"）转码为制度话语对教师主体性的规训与压缩，而不是停留在故事讲述层面。

title: The Act of Telling, the Work of Becoming: Multiracial Teacher Identity Development
author: Sara Yuen Marcopulos

relevance: 这篇论文与你今日主线"Teacher vulnerability, dual language immersion, and institutional discourse"在"教师身份建构与制度话语张力"这一层上高度相关：它同样关注教师如何在单一种族假设的制度环境中经历身份的不可见与误读，这与你稿件中DLI教师在单语制度话语下的脆弱性处境形成直接的结构类比。

title: Understanding How Emergent Bilinguals Bridge Belonging and Languages in Dual Language Immersion Settings
author: Marialuisa Di Stefano
abstract: The purpose of this study was to understand how young children bridge belonging and language in a dual language immersion (DLI) setting. I developed a 10-week ethnographic study in a Spanish-English third-grade class in the Northeast of the U.S. where data was collected in the form of field notes, interviews, and artifacts. Here I explored the way language instruction and student participation inf…
relevance: 这篇论文与你今日主线"Teacher vulnerability, dual language immersion, and institutional discourse"在场景层高度重合——同为DLI课堂的民族志研究，且同时关注教师与学生身份的交互建构，可为你的稿件提供直接的对话文献和DLI身份研究的定位坐标。

title: WAC/WID in the Age of Trans-: Crossing and Re-crossing Borders of Discipline, Language, and Identity
author: Jonathan Hall
journal: The WAC Clearinghouse; University Press of Colorado eBooks
abstract: This collection investigates the challenges and opportunities for the teaching of academic writing brought on by the increasing, and the increasing recognition of, the mobility across linguistic, national, disciplinary, and institutional borders of teachers, students, scholars, and institutional programs.As chapters in this collection demonstrate, the teaching, practice, and study of academic writ…
relevance: 这篇论文（合集导论）与你今日主线"Translanguaging, identity negotiation, and action research in EMI classrooms"在理论定位层高度相关：它将translanguaging/trans-视角嵌入学术写作教学（WAC/WID）的学科框架中，讨论跨语言、跨学科、跨身份流动如何重塑写作实践，这与你EMI稿件中"translanguaging不仅是课堂策略，更是身份协商与知识建构的变革性实践"的核心论证方向直接对话。

title: Dialogic Foundations of the “4-trans” Framework
author: David Martínez‐Prieto, Sandra I. Musanti, Xiaodi Zhou
abstract: In this article, we develop the “4-trans” framework by reflecting on the way current multilingual teacher preparation scholarship has addressed translanguaging, transnationalism, transculturality, and transdisciplinarity either in compartmentalized or integrative manners. While current literature has addressed some “trans” intersections, we propose the enunciation of the “4-trans” as permeable and…
relevance: 这篇论文与你今日主线"Translanguaging, identity negotiation, and action research in EMI classrooms"在理论框架层高度相关：它试图将translanguaging与transnationalism、transculturality、transdisciplinarity整合为一个统一的"4-trans"框架，这直接回应了你在EMI稿件中需要处理的核心张力——如何把translanguaging不仅当作语言实践，还与身份协商（transculturality/transnationalism维度）和学科知识建构（transdisciplinarity维度）系统关联起来，而不是让这些概念各自悬浮。

title: Ideologies of teachers and students towards meso-level English-medium instruction policy and translanguaging in the STEM classroom at a Malaysian university
author: Mohammad Mosiur Rahman, Md Shaiful Islam, Abdul Karim et al.
abstract: Abstract English medium instruction (EMI) as a language policy in higher education is based on monolingual conceptions and limits the use of the full linguistic repertoire of bilinguals/multilinguals in the university classroom. Informed by the constructs of language ideology (Spolsky, Bernard. 2009. Language management . Cambridge, UK: Cambridge University Press), translanguaging (Li, Wei. 2018. …
relevance: 这篇论文与你今日主线"Translanguaging, identity negotiation, and action research in EMI classrooms"高度相关，因为它同样聚焦EMI政策下translanguaging的实际运作，且从language ideology视角考察教师与学生对translanguaging的态度——这正是你稿件中需要处理的"EMI政策的单语意识形态如何制约或促进课堂translanguaging实践"这一张力的另一个切入点。不过，该文侧重meso-level政策层面的ideology分析（Spolsky的语言管理框架），而非你所关注的identity negotiation与action research驱动的教师转变叙事，因此它与你的研究问题只在"政策-实践张力"这一层重叠，并非核心对标。

title: From Willingness to Competence: Investigating Primary Teachers’ Readiness for EMI Implementation
author: Devinta Puspita Ratri, Agus Gozali, Dian Inayati et al.
abstract: English as a Medium of Instruction (EMI) is increasingly promoted in Indonesian primary schools to accelerate bilingual competence, yet evidence on teacher readiness remains limited. This explanatory sequential qualitative-methods study examined the EMI readiness of 108 teachers from elementary schools in East Java. An adapted 16-item EMI-Readiness Scale (α =.89) and three open-ended prompts captu…
relevance: 这篇论文与你今日主线"Translanguaging, identity negotiation, and action research in EMI classrooms"仅在EMI这一宏观场景上重合，但研究问题指向的是教师就绪度（readiness）的量表测量与描述，而非课堂内translanguaging实践或身份协商，理论层和方法层都距离你的稿件较远。

title: Teaching Hispanic Restaurant Workers: Translanguaging as Culturally Sustaining Pedagogy
author: Mark R. Emerick, B Hoffman, Yasuko Kanno
abstract: In this article, we make a case for incorporating translanguaging pedagogy into the framework of Culturally Sustaining Pedagogy (CSP). Drawing on data from a one‐year ethnographic study of an adult ESL program, we show how teachers believed in and attempted to create spaces for translanguaging and CSP but in practice fell short. We conclude that translanguaging is most powerful when understood as …
relevance: 这篇论文与你今日主线"Translanguaging, identity negotiation, and action research in EMI classrooms"在理论层面高度相关——它试图将translanguaging嵌入一个更大的教学理论框架（Culturally Sustaining Pedagogy），这与你稿件中将translanguaging定位为"transformative practice"并连接身份协商的论证策略形成直接对话。最值得借鉴的是它的问题意识与论证结构上的落差处理：文章的核心张力在于教师"believed in and attempted"与"in practice fell short"之间的gap，这种"理念-实践错位"的论证框架恰恰是你在action research稿件中需要警惕和参照的——你的稿件同样面临如何把课堂发现写成"不只是经验报告"的挑战，而这篇文章示范了如何通过ethnographic evidence呈现理想与落地之间的裂隙来构建可发表的学术论证，而非简单宣称translanguaging有效。不过需注意，该文语境为成人ESL而非EMI，且缺少action research的方法论自反性，因此方法设计层面的可借鉴性有限。

title: Translanguaging for Equity and Justice in Assessment: A Systematic Review
author: Zhongfeng Tian, Jamie L. Schissel, Chia-Hsin Yin et al.
abstract: This systematic review examines how translanguaging has been integrated into educational assessment, a domain historically dominated by monolingual norms. Drawing on 33 empirical studies published between 2012 and 2023, we employed an inductive–deductive coding approach to analyze how translanguaging is enacted across assessment types and its implications for teaching, learning, and equity. relevance: 这篇系统综述聚焦translanguaging在评估领域的应用，与你今日主线（EMI课堂中的translanguaging与身份协商）在理论根基上共享translanguaging框架，但其核心关切是评估公平而非课堂互动中的身份建构，因此属于"理论层相关、问题域相邻但不重叠"的关系——它更直接地服务于你AP Chinese/LAQ那条评估政策稿件。

title: When Structuralism and Post-structuralism Collide: EMI Lecturers’ Monolingual Ideology and Translanguaging Practice
author: Jinghe Han
abstract: Abstract This Chapter activated a post-structuralist translanguaging perspective to investigate the Chinese EMI lecturers’ position and practice as bilingual educators. Data reveal that there was an observed distinction between the Chinese EMI lecturers’ ideology of language and pedagogical practices. In the mainstream the lecturers were not confident with their English capabilities and presented …
relevance: 这篇论文直接对应你今日主线"Translanguaging, identity negotiation, and action research in EMI classrooms"，核心关切几乎重叠：中国EMI教师在单语意识形态与实际translanguaging实践之间的张力，以及这种张力如何塑造其教育者身份——这正是你稿件中需要对话的关键文献之一，尤其在"教师声称支持English-only但实际部署translanguaging作为认知与教学生存策略"这一发现上，可以帮你锐化你自己稿件中ideology-practice gap的论证锚点。

title: Translanguaging as method
author: Li Wei
abstract: This article argues that translanguaging itself is a methodology offering a new conceptual framework that promotes a number of important analytical shifts: shift away from language as abstract codes to meaning- and sense-making; attend to a wider range of multi-semiotic resources whilst refusing to privilege particular modes and methods of meaning-making over others; approach translanguaging as an…
relevance: 这篇论文直接对应你今日主线中"数字第三空间里translanguaging的功能分类与多模态资源"这一核心议题。它将translanguaging从研究对象提升为方法论框架，主张分析时不预设语码边界、不特权化某种符号模式——这恰好为你在小红书稿件中处理文字、图片、emoji等多模态资源的不对称功能提供了方法论层面的辩护依据。

title: The online activism of mock translanguaging: Language style, celebrity persona, and social class in China
author: Shuang Gao
abstract: This paper examines a viral language style that emerged during online activism against a Chinese celebrity after she was announced the winner of an architecture award. relevance: 这篇论文与你今日主线"Chinese-English translanguaging in digital third spaces and identity work"在平台语境中的translanguaging功能分类这一层高度相关：它同样聚焦中国社交媒体上中英混用的符号实践，并将translanguaging拆解为具体的社会功能（情感动员、团结建构、集体行动），这与你在小红书稿件中对translanguaging不对称功能的分类工作形成直接对话——尤其是它所揭示的"mock translanguaging"如何与阶层身份和道德话语挂钩，可以帮助你在Beyond Deficit稿件中更锐利地论证translanguaging并非中性工具，而是嵌入权力与身份协商的实践。

title: Korean language teachers’ vulnerability over English competency in Korean-only classrooms
author: Juyoung Song

abstract: Abstract The recent trend of the internationalization of higher education has increased the significance of English as a medium of instruction and communication on campus in non-English speaking countries. relevance: 这篇论文与你今日主线"Teacher vulnerability, dual language immersion, and institutional discourse"高度对齐——它同样聚焦语言教师在机构语言政策（Korean-only norm）下因语言能力而产生的情感脆弱性，与你稿件中DLI教师在制度话语中的vulnerability构成直接的跨语境对话，尤其在"制度规范如何被教师差异化内化与执行"这一分析层面可形成有力的互文参照。

title: Translanguaging in a Chinese university CLIL classroom: Teacher strategies and student attitudes
author: Xiaozhou Zhou, Steve Mann
journal: Studies in Second Language Learning and Teaching
abstract: Pedagogical translanguaging has been extensively researched over the past decade. Yet, little is known about the attitudes of students towards this practice. Students constitute an integral part of classroom interactions and their learning process is significantly affected by teachers’ classroom discourse. relevance: 这篇论文与你今日主线"Translanguaging, identity negotiation, and action research in EMI classrooms"高度重合：同样聚焦中国大学CLIL/EMI课堂中教师的translanguaging策略，同样采用行动研究设计并结合课堂录像与问卷，研究场景、方法路径乃至研究问题的措辞都与你的活跃稿件直接对标，是你在定位自身贡献（contribution statement）和区分已有文献（gap articulation）时必须正面处理的一篇文章。

title: Translanguaging as a political stance: implications for English language education
author: Li Wei
abstract: Abstract Following the multilingual trend in language education, translanguaging advocates active use of multiple languages and other meaning-making resources in a dynamic and integrated way in teaching and learning. When it comes to foreign language education, translanguaging advocates a view that the languages the learners already have should and can play a very positive role in learning additio…
relevance: 这篇论文直接对应你今日主线"Translanguaging, identity negotiation, and action research in EMI classrooms"，尤其是它将translanguaging定位为一种政治立场而非单纯的教学策略，这恰好能帮助你在稿件中论证EMI语法课堂里translanguaging实践不只是语言资源的灵活调用，而是涉及权力分配与身份协商的制度性选择——这一层政治性论证正是把课堂发现从"经验总结"推向"可发表论证"的关键杠杆。

title: Constructing Playful Talk through Translanguaging in English Medium Instruction Mathematics Classrooms
author: Kevin W. H. Tai, Li Wei
abstract: Abstract Recent studies on English-Medium-Instruction (EMI) classroom interaction have begun to look at the role of translanguaging as a pedagogical practice in supporting participants to exploit multilingual and multimodal resources to facilitate content teaching and learning. relevance: 这篇论文与你今日主线"Translanguaging, identity negotiation, and action research in EMI classrooms"高度相关：它同样聚焦EMI课堂中translanguaging的微观互动实践，且将分析粒度下沉到具体的话语策略（playful talk），展示了如何从课堂录像中提取可论证的互动片段——这恰好是你当前稿件需要解决的核心问题，即如何把课堂发现从"经验描述"升级为"可发表的论证"。

title: Becoming and being a teacher through emotion discourse: a case study of a novice EMI teacher

abstract: While the research field of English-as-Medium-of-Instruction (EMI) in China has experienced growth in recent years, covering topics ranging from top-down policies to classroom implementations and teachers’ needs, there has been limited attention given to the lived emotional experiences of EMI teachers and how such experiences influence their teaching practices and identity construction. relevance: 这篇论文与你今日主线"Translanguaging, identity negotiation, and action research in EMI classrooms"高度相关，但切入角度不同：它聚焦于情感话语（emotion discourse）如何塑造EMI教师身份，而你的稿件侧重translanguaging实践如何介入身份协商。这恰好为你提供了一个"身份建构"维度的对话点——你可以在论证中明确区分你的研究贡献与"情感-身份"路径的差异，说明translanguaging不仅是情感层面的应对策略，更是具有变革性的教学实践，从而让你的研究问题更尖锐、定位更精准。

relevance: 这篇是Gee的经典话语分析教材，与用户今日主线直接相关但属于基础理论工具层而非前沿对话层。Gee的"七大建构任务"（尤其是identities、relationships、sign systems）和"figured worlds"等分析工具，正是用户在Xiaohongshu稿件中论证translanguaging如何完成身份建构（identity work）时可直接调用的分析框架——特别是在将功能分类与身份论证衔接时，figured worlds可以帮助解释用户为何将某些translanguaging实践归入特定功能类别，使编码逻辑更可辩护。

title: Racial integration through two-way dual language immersion: A case study
author: Elizabeth M. Uzzell, Jennifer B. Ayscue
abstract: Despite increasingly diverse public school enrollment, students across the U.S. are still segregated by race and poverty, and English learners (ELs) often experience triple segregation by race, poverty, and language. Two-way immersion (TWI) programs may create racially integrated learning environments, by offering a dual language model that balances native English speakers and speakers of the part…
relevance: 这篇论文直接贴合你今日主线"Teacher vulnerability, dual language immersion, and institutional discourse"中的DLI制度语境维度——它聚焦TWI项目如何在制度层面促成（或未能促成）种族整合，为你分析教师脆弱性的制度根源提供了关键的结构性背景，即教师所处的DLI项目本身承载着哪些种族、语言与资源分配的制度张力。最值得借鉴的是它的问题意识构建方式：论文从一个看似积极的制度安排（TWI促进整合）切入，却通过案例揭示其中的结构性矛盾（隔离的持续与再生产），这种"制度承诺与实际落差"的框架恰好可以帮助你在稿件中把教师的个人叙事（"find the guts"式的情感经历）提升为对制度话语与教师处境之间结构性错位的分析，避免停留在叙事层面而缺乏制度批判的锐度。

title: Dueling Roles in Dual Language Education: Exploring Leader Identity Development in Dual Language Strands
author: Colleen E. Chesnut, Trish Morita‐Mullaney
abstract: Purpose: Building on research in educational leadership, dual language leadership, and leader identity development, this study examines how principals of schools with dual language immersion (DLI) strands perceive and enact their leadership roles and identities. As DLI strands proliferate in schools and districts, this research contributes to understandings of principals’ leader identities as they…
relevance: 这篇论文直接对应你今日主线"Teacher vulnerability, dual language immersion, and institutional discourse"中的DLI制度层面，但它的切入点是校长（leader）而非教师，因此与你稿件中教师脆弱性的视角形成互补而非重叠——它展示的是制度话语的"另一端"，即管理者如何在DLI strand结构中建构身份、分配角色，这恰好是教师vulnerability的制度来源之一。

title: Designing Critical Multilingual Multiliteracies Projects in Two-Way Immersion Classrooms: Affordances and Impacts on Students
author: Jungwon Hyun, Esther Bettney Heidt, Gail Prasad
abstract: Language separation policies in two-way bilingual education (TWBE) reflect ideologies of double monolingualism (Heller, 1995) and ignore the sociolinguistic realities of bi/multilingual students (García & Lin, 2017). This case study investigates the design and implementation of collaborative multilingual identity text projects (Prasad, 2018) in a Spanish-English two-way immersion (TWI) school.…
relevance: 这篇论文与你今日主线"Teacher vulnerability, dual language immersion, and institutional discourse"在双语沉浸教育的制度意识形态层面直接相关：它聚焦TWI学校中语言分离政策背后的"双重单语主义"意识形态，并通过课堂项目设计试图松动这一制度逻辑，这与你稿件中教师在DLI制度话语下所经历的脆弱性形成互补——它从学生端和课程设计端呈现了同一制度压力的另一面。

title: Translanguaging and emotionality of English as a second language (ESL) teachers
author: Sarah Hopkyns, Sender Dovchin
journal: IRAL - International Review of Applied Linguistics in Language Teaching
abstract: Abstract Teaching is by no means ‘an emotion-free zone’, and teachers are often emotionally challenged in front of their students. When teaching and learning takes place via a second language, the emotional landscape of the classroom becomes especially charged. Often there is a notable gap between expected emotions or ‘emotional rules’ in English as a Second Language (ESL) classrooms and genuine e…
relevance: 这篇论文最贴近你今日主线中"translanguaging与身份/情感工作"这一维度：它从ESL教师的情感劳动（emotional labour）出发，论证"English only"单语意识形态如何制造情感规则与真实情感之间的裂隙，而translanguaging则成为教师抵抗这种意识形态压力、重建情感主体性的资源——这与你Xiaohongshu稿件中用户通过中英translanguaging在数字第三空间进行身份协商、超越deficit定位的论证逻辑形成对话。

title: Internationalisation at Home through Critical Virtual Exchange
author: Mirjam Hauck, Ana Cristina Biondo Salomão, Müge Satar et al.
abstract: Abstract Virtual Exchange (VE) refers to structured online collaborative learning between geographically and/or culturally diverse groups of students, aimed at fostering intercultural dialogue through digitally mediated project work. VE is a research-informed practice and serves as a valuable tool in advancing Internationalisation at Home (IaH) in Higher Education (HE), integrating intercultural d…
relevance: 这篇论文与你今日主线"Translanguaging, identity negotiation, and action research in EMI classrooms"的关联处于间接/方法层面：它同样关注高等教育国际化情境下的权力不对等与批判性教学实践，但其核心场景是虚拟交换（Virtual Exchange）而非EMI课堂，也未直接涉及translanguaging或课堂互动中的身份协商。不过，论文对"某一教学实践并非天然包容/公平"这一批判性问题意识的提出方式，与你在EMI稿件中论证translanguaging不应被浪漫化、需要在具体制度条件下审视其转化性潜力的逻辑高度同构。

title: Tackling Climate Change with Machine Learning
author: Lynn H. Kaack, David Rolnick, Priya L. Donti et al.
abstract: Climate change is one of the greatest challenges facing humanity, and we, as machine learning experts, may wonder how we can help. Here we describe how machine learning can be a powerful tool in reducing greenhouse gas emissions and helping society adapt to a changing climate. From smart grids to disaster management, we identify high impact problems where existing gaps can be filled by machine lea…
relevance: 这篇论文与你今日主线及活跃稿件几乎完全不相关。它聚焦于机器学习在气候变化领域的应用场景，既不涉及社交平台多模态话语、语言身份建构，也不涉及应用语言学的任何理论或方法层面。

title: Translanguaging in Primary Level ESL Classroom in India: An Exploratory Study
author: Lina Mukhopadhyay
journal: International Journal of English Language Teaching
abstract: In this paper, a series of ESL classroom observations of a teacher in an Indian primary level government run school are presented to show concrete uses of translanguaging. Translanguaging practices were based on the inputs the teacher received from a training programme on using multilingual strategies to teach language and content. It is observed that the teacher applies translanguaging to clarify…
relevance: 这篇论文与你今日主线"Translanguaging, identity negotiation, and action research in EMI classrooms"在表层主题上高度重叠——都涉及教师在课堂中实施translanguaging的具体实践，且教师行为源于外部培训输入后的自主调适，与你稿件中action research驱动的教师转变有结构性相似。但它停留在exploratory描述层面，缺乏identity negotiation维度和系统的理论论证框架，因此相关性主要在方法设计与结果呈现这一层，而非问题意识或理论贡献层。

title: How Do EFL Learners Construct Identity and Make Investments in Multilingual English Classrooms? A Narrative Case Study
author: M. Faruq Ubaidillah, Emy Sudarwati, Erikson Saragih et al.
abstract: Multilingual English classrooms in Indonesia are seen as sites of identity struggles for the teaching and learning of English as a foreign language. However, the extent to which learners construct identities and make investments in such classrooms remains unclear. To fill the lacuna, this narrative case study investigated how Indonesian EFL learners construct their multilingual identities and inve…
relevance: 这篇论文与你今日主线"Translanguaging, identity negotiation, and action research in EMI classrooms"在身份建构这一层直接相关，但侧重点有差异：它聚焦的是EFL学习者通过叙事个案呈现身份与投资（investment），而你的稿件关注的是教师行动研究视角下EMI课堂中translanguaging如何催化身份协商。两者共享Norton的identity/investment理论资源，但该文缺少行动研究与课堂互动层面的设计，因此对你的方法论启发有限。

title: Review of recent empirical research (2011–2018) on language assessment in China
author: Shangchao Min, Lianzhen He, Jie Zhang
abstract: Abstract This article reviews a selected sample of 70 empirical studies in journal articles and doctoral dissertations on language assessment in China between 2011 and 2018. Following a brief introduction to the history and current state of language assessment in China, the article presents a critical review of language assessment research on six themes that have aroused the greatest interest from…
relevance: 这篇综述聚焦中国语境下的语言评估实证研究，与你今日主线"AP Chinese assessment"同属语言测评领域，但其关注的是中国国内考试（如CET、TEM等）的信效度、反拨效应等议题，与你稿件所批判的美国制度性评估框架（College Board / AP考试中的元语言不对称与知识权威分配）在制度语境、理论立场和批判深度上差异明显，属于"领域相关但问题意识层不相关"。

title: Portfolio Based Language Assessment (PBLA) in Language Instruction for Newcomers to Canada (LINC) Programs: Taking Stock of Teachers' Experience
author: Nwara Abdulhamid, Janna Fox
abstract: This study examined seven Language Instruction for Newcomers to Canada (LINC) teachers’ accounts of current Portfolio Based Language Assessment (PBLA) practices, elicited through semi-structured interviews, in order to explore washback - the effects of PBLA on teaching and learning. Portfolios are primarily useful as formative assessment tools (i.e., informing teaching and learning) (Fox, 2014; Li…
relevance: 这篇论文与你今日主线"AP Chinese assessment, metalinguistic asymmetry, and epistemic authority"在制度性评估政策对教学的反拨效应（washback）这一层高度相关：PBLA作为国家层面强制推行的评估框架如何重塑教师实践、限制教学自主权，与你对AP Chinese考试框架如何通过评分标准分配认识论权威（epistemic authority）、制造元语言不对称的批判逻辑共享同一条制度批判主线——都是在追问"评估文件如何成为权力装置"。

title: Engaging students in learning and creating different translanguaging sub-spaces in Hong Kong English Medium Instruction history classrooms
author: Kevin W. H. Tai, Li Wei
abstract: A key pedagogical goal in any classroom is to engage students in learning. This study examines how an English-Medium-Instruction (EMI) teacher employs available resources to engage his students in the classroom for promoting participation, keeping the lesson moving forward and meeting the pedagogical goals. The data for this study is based on a intensive fieldwork in an EMI secondary history class…
relevance: 这篇论文与你今日主线"Translanguaging, identity negotiation, and action research in EMI classrooms"高度相关，但侧重点不同：它聚焦香港EMI历史课堂中教师如何通过多模态资源创造不同的translanguaging sub-spaces以推动学生参与，而你的稿件关注的是EMI语法课堂中translanguaging与身份协商的关系及行动研究路径。这篇文章最值得借鉴的是方法设计与证据链的呈现方式——它以多模态会话分析（Multimodal CA）处理课堂互动数据，并用视频刺激回忆访谈做三角验证，这种"微观互动片段＋参与者元话语"的双层证据结构恰好能帮助你把课堂发现从经验总结升级为可辩护的论证：你可以参照它如何从具体互动序列中系统地提炼出"sub-spaces"这类分析性概念，使课堂数据不仅是例证而是构成论点本身的证据链，这对你当前"如何把课堂发现写成可发表的论证"的写作目标直接有用。

title: Investment, linguistic capital and identity in Chinese university students’ EMI experience
author: Wang Ying, Jiang Dong
abstract: In line with China's vision for international education, English medium instruction (EMI) is booming in Chinese higher education, which positions Chinese students in circumstances where they need to negotiate among different commitments, roles, identities, and desires involving individual, national and international agendas. This paper draws on the investment theory and model developed by Norton a…
relevance: 这篇论文与你今日主线"Translanguaging, identity negotiation, and action research in EMI classrooms"直接相关，尤其在EMI情境下的身份协商维度上高度吻合——它同样聚焦中国高校EMI学生如何在多重身份、欲望与资本之间进行投资与协商，与你稿件中"identity negotiation"的理论关切形成对话，可帮助你精确定位自己研究在"学生身份"与"教师身份/教学实践"之间的差异性贡献。

title: Migrant Maths Teachers: Deficit, Translanguaging, and Growing Authority
author: Alan Benson
abstract: This article draws from a longitudinal case study of trainee (the term used in official documentation related to Initial Teacher Training (ITT) in England and with some reservations throughout this paper) and early-career teachers (ECT) of mathematics. The sample represents migrant teachers that the Immigration Act of 2020 seeks to attract to the UK to address national shortages identified by the …
relevance: 这篇论文与你今日主线"Translanguaging, identity negotiation, and action research in EMI classrooms"高度相关，但切入角度不同：它聚焦的是移民教师在英国数学课堂中如何通过translanguaging和多模态符号资源从"deficit"定位走向专业权威的身份协商过程，与你稿件中EMI教师在行动研究中重新定位自身语言身份的论证线索形成直接对话。

title: “I Don't Let What I Don't Know Stop What I Can do”—How Monolingual English Teachers Constructed a Translanguaging<scp>Pre‐K</scp>Classroom in China
author: Lijuan Shi, Kellie Rolstad
abstract: Abstract Guided by translanguaging pedagogy, this study examines how monolingual English teachers in a Pre‐K school in China navigate between English and Chinese to construct a translanguaging classroom. Findings based on classroom observations and interviews reveal that, despite being constrained by their monolingualism, the English teachers enacted translanguaging in multiple ways creating three…
relevance: 这篇论文与你今日主线"Chinese-English translanguaging in digital third spaces and identity work"存在理论层面的关联但语境差异较大：它同样处理中英translanguaging的功能分类（assistance, assessment, showcases），与你在Xiaohongshu稿件中对translanguaging asymmetric functions的分类逻辑形成对话，但其研究场域是线下Pre-K课堂、参与者是单语教师，与你关注的数字第三空间和用户自发身份建构有本质不同。

title: Teacher anger as a double-edged sword: Contrasting trait and emotional labor effects
author: Hui Wang, Ming Ming Chiu, Nathan C. Hall
abstract: Abstract In contrast to teachers’ positive emotions, such as enjoyment and enthusiasm, teachers’ negative emotions and the regulation of negative emotions have received limited empirical attention. As the most commonly experienced negative emotion in teachers, anger has to date demonstrated mixed effects on teacher development. On the one hand, habitual experiences of anger (i.e., trait anger ) ex…
relevance: 这篇论文与你今日主线"Teacher vulnerability, dual language immersion, and institutional discourse"在情感维度上有交集，但交集较窄：它关注的是教师愤怒的特质层面与情绪劳动效应，属于教育心理学量化框架，而你的稿件核心在于制度话语如何制造教师脆弱性，属于批判话语与制度分析路径，两者问题意识和认识论差异明显。

title: School Management Culture, Emotional Labor, and Teacher Burnout in Mainland China
author: Kwok Kuen Tsang, Yuan Teng, Yi Lian et al.
abstract: The literature suggests that teacher burnout is influenced by the market and hierarchy cultures of school management and teachers’ emotional labor strategies of surface and deep acting. However, studies have suggested that school management cultures and emotional labor strategies may not function independently based on the emotional labor theory. Nevertheless, the literature has paid less attentio…
relevance: 这篇论文与你今日主线"Teacher vulnerability, dual language immersion, and institutional discourse"在制度环境对教师情感状态的结构性影响这一层面相关，但相关性停留在主题邻近而非直接对接：它关注的是中国大陆学校管理文化、情绪劳动与职业倦怠之间的量化中介关系，而你的稿件聚焦的是DLI场景下教师脆弱性如何被制度话语建构，两者在理论传统（情绪劳动理论 vs. 批判话语/制度分析）和方法论（量化问卷路径分析 vs. 质性叙事-结构分析）上差异显著。

title: Discursive construction of online teacher identity and legitimacy in English language teaching
author: Wing Yee Jenifer Ho
abstract: The paper investigates YouTube teachers’ identity construction within dominant language ideologies. Drawing on the constructs of language teacher professional identity, social media micro-celebrity persona, linguistic entrepreneurship, and raciolinguistic ideologies and online persona, the study analyses banner images, biographies, and semi-structured interviews of online teachers and provides a f…
relevance: 这篇论文与你今日主线"数字第三空间中的translanguaging与身份建构"在平台身份论证这一层高度相关：它同样聚焦数字平台上的身份建构，同样处理多模态资源（banner images、biographies）与话语策略如何在语言意识形态框架下协商合法性，这与你在小红书稿件中论证translanguaging如何超越"deficit"叙事、实现身份工作的核心关切直接对话。

title: A survey on sentiment analysis methods, applications, and challenges
author: Mayur Wankhade, Annavarapu Chandra Sekhara Rao, Chaitanya Kulkarni
relevance: 这篇论文属于计算机科学/自然语言处理领域的综述，聚焦情感分析的技术方法与工程应用，与你今日主线"社交平台多模态话语、可供性与身份建构"以及活跃稿件Xiaohongshu研究的关联性极为有限。虽然情感分析在技术层面也处理社交媒体文本，但它的核心关切是分类算法的精度与效率，而非话语如何在平台上建构身份、分配权力，与你的批判话语分析取向和多模态数据链写作目标基本不在同一问题域。

title: Banglalish on social media: A corpus-based study of Bangla–English code-mixing across four platforms in Bangladesh
author: Shajadul Alam Sweet, Md. Nurul Kabir Emon, Sadia Khandokar Mim et al.
abstract: This article reports a 12-month, 120,000-token corpus study of Bangla–English codemixing in Bangladesh’s social-media discourse across Facebook, Twitter, YouTube, and Instagram. Anchored in variational sociolinguistics and contact linguistics, we operationalise code-mixing using the Matrix Language Frame (MLF) model and related structural diagnostics (insertion vs. alternation; borrowing vs. switc…
relevance: 这篇论文与你今日主线"Chinese-English translanguaging in digital third spaces"在跨平台社交媒体双语实践这一层面直接相关，但理论取向有根本差异：它锚定在变异社会语言学和MLF结构分类框架内，关注的是code-mixing的频率与结构类型（insertion vs. alternation），而你的Xiaohongshu稿件从批判后结构主义出发，强调translanguaging的身份功能与权力不对称——因此它更多是一个可供方法设计对话的参照物，而非理论同盟。

title: Interaction in the Multilingual Classroom
author: Marie Källkvist, Erica Sandlund, Pia Sundqvist et al.
abstract: Classroom language ecologies are increasingly diverse as a result of mobility, migration, and information technology. In these spaces, interlocutors may draw upon shared linguistic and cultural resources but also bring in others. Prime examples are additional-language (AL) classrooms, where there is a shared target language, but where students may have different first languages from their classmat…
relevance: 这篇综述章节直接对应今日主线"Translanguaging, identity negotiation, and action research in EMI classrooms"，尤其是它将translanguaging与课堂互动分析（CA、民族志等）并置讨论多语课堂中的资源调配，能帮助你在稿件中更精准地定位自己的方法论选择相对于该领域其他互动研究路径的独特性与互补性。

title: Translanguaging in English-medium instruction (EMI): Examining English literature content classrooms
author: Ufuk Ataş
abstract: Recently, translanguaging has begun challenging and replacing English-only policies in English-medium instruction (EMI) contexts, advocating that bi/multilingual learners may better internalise information in two or more languages. Within this perspective and using linguistic ethnography as the framework, this case study examines the translanguaging practices used by the instructor and the student…
relevance: 这篇论文与你今日主线"Translanguaging, identity negotiation, and action research in EMI classrooms"高度贴合——它同样聚焦EMI课堂中translanguaging的实际使用，并试图论证这些实践如何中介学习，与你稿件中关注的translanguaging如何在EMI语法课堂中发挥转化作用形成直接对话。不过它侧重的是英语文学内容课堂，且采用语言民族志而非行动研究框架，身份协商也并非其核心关切，因此与你稿件的理论锚点和方法论路径存在明确差异。

title: EMI and translanguaging: Student language use in an Italian English-taught programme
author: Fiona Dalziel
abstract: Italian universities are striving to enhance their internationalization policies through the implementation of English-Medium Instruction (Costa & Coleman 2013) and the University of Padova is no exception, with a total of 49 fully English-taught programmes (ETPs) now on offer. Yet this phenomenon is problematic, with ongoing concerns about guaranteeing quality (Beccaria 2015; Wilkinson 2013) …
relevance: 这篇论文直接对应你今日主线"Translanguaging, identity negotiation, and action research in EMI classrooms"，尤其在EMI课堂中学生实际语言使用（translanguaging实践）的实证描写层面高度相关——它从意大利语境出发考察英语授课项目中本地语言与英语的交织使用，与你稿件中中国EMI语法课堂的translanguaging实践形成跨语境对话。

title: Translingual practice as a discursive strategy to shape lifestyle and cultural identity
author: Yunhong Wang, Boyang Peng, Xiaoli Tang
abstract: The paper presents a comprehensive examination of the influence of online translingual practice on the lifestyle choices and identity construction of Chinese youth. An analysis of data sourced from platforms such as Weibo and Xiaohongshu finds that the emergence of new lifestyles facilitated by translingual practice transcends traditional social norms, leading to notable shifts in lifestyle prefer…
relevance: 这篇论文与你今日主线"Chinese-English translanguaging in digital third spaces and identity work"高度对齐：它同样聚焦小红书等中国社交平台上的跨语言实践，并将其与身份建构和生活方式话语直接关联，构成你Beyond Deficit稿件最直接的对话文献之一。

title: Learning Mandarin-as-a-Foreign Language: Communities of Practice and Translanguaging
author: Yajie Zhang
abstract: Mandarin-as-a-foreign-language (MFL) courses are popular in English-medium international schools in China where international students are often bilingual or multilingual. These students may choose to communicate in more than one language. This research investigates teachers’ and students’ perceptions of language choices while teaching and learning MFL at an English-medium i…
relevance: 这篇论文与你今日主线"Translanguaging, identity negotiation, and action research in EMI classrooms"在场景层高度重叠——同样聚焦中国EMI环境下的translanguaging实践，且涉及多语学生的语言选择与课堂社群构建，可以直接作为你稿件的文献对话对象，帮助你在literature review中精确定位自己研究的差异贡献（如：该文侧重师生感知/Communities of Practice框架，而你的稿件聚焦身份协商与教师行动研究的变革性维度）。最值得借鉴的是问题意识的边界设定方式：它将translanguaging限定在"MFL课堂中的language choices及师生对此的perceptions"，问题清晰但偏描述性，恰好可以反衬你的稿件如何把问题写得更"尖锐"——从描述"是否/如何translanguage"推进到"translanguaging如何成为身份协商的变革工具"，从而避免你的论证停留在经验总结层面。

relevance: 这篇论文与你今日主线"Translanguaging, identity negotiation, and action research in EMI classrooms"直接相关，尤其在"教师能动性（teacher agency）与translanguaging在EMI政策下的互动关系"这一层面与你的稿件共享核心关切——你的稿件聚焦EMI语法课堂中教师通过行动研究推动translanguaging实践，而这篇则从民族志视角考察教师如何在政策压力下自发生成translanguaging agency，两者构成"自上而下的行动研究干预"与"自下而上的教师自发策略"之间的对话。

title: Exploring Emerging Translanguaging Practices among International Undergraduates in EAP Courses in South Korea

relevance: 这篇论文与你今日主线"Translanguaging, identity negotiation, and action research in EMI classrooms"高度吻合：同样聚焦EMI语境下自然涌现的translanguaging实践，同样以教师-研究者视角反思英语唯一政策的局限，且研究场景（韩国大学EAP课堂中的国际学生）与你的中国EMI语法课堂形成可直接对话的平行案例。

title: Assessment for learning or assessment for scoring? Washback of analytic rubrics in Vietnamese EFL classrooms
author: Hoang Yen Phuong, Lê Thanh Thảo, Trut Thuy Pham

title: Standardized proficiency tests in a campus-wide English curriculum: a washback study

relevance: 这篇论文与你今日主线"AP Chinese assessment, metalinguistic asymmetry, and epistemic authority"在评估反拨效应（washback）这一层面上存在方法与问题意识的交集：两者都关注标准化考试如何通过制度设计反向塑造教与学的实践，但该文聚焦的是高等教育英语水平测试对学生学习行为的影响，与你所做的AP中文文件层面的批判性话语分析在理论深度和分析对象上差异明显——它更偏向经验性washback研究，缺少你所需要的认识论权威（epistemic authority）或元语言不对称视角。

title: From tests to tasks: how Vietnamese EFL teachers navigate washback through formative assessment practices

abstract: In Vietnamese English language classrooms, assessment has long been shaped by the weight of summative exams and the pressures of test-oriented instruction. relevance: 这篇论文与你今日主线"Translanguaging, identity negotiation, and action research in EMI classrooms"高度贴合：它同样聚焦EMI课堂中语言选择与教师身份建构的关系，且以真实课堂互动数据为分析对象，直接对话你稿件中"translanguaging如何介入身份协商"这一核心论点。

title: Competence beyond language: translanguaging and spatial repertoire in teacher-student interaction in a music classroom in an international Chinese University
author: Amy Wanyu Ou, Mingyue Gu

abstract: Previous research on classroom interaction in international university contexts tended to focus on individual speakers’ language (in)competence. relevance: 这篇论文与你今日主线"Translanguaging, identity negotiation, and action research in EMI classrooms"在理论视角上直接相关，但侧重点有所偏移：它将translanguaging从语言能力框架拓展到spatial repertoire与多模态符号资源的组装，关注的是课堂沟通如何超越个体语言能力，而非身份协商或教师行动研究。对你的EMI稿件而言，它最值得借鉴的是问题意识的锐化方式——论文开篇即以"competence beyond language"挑战既有研究将课堂互动窄化为个体语言（不）能力的倾向，这种"精准否定已有文献默认前提"的写法，正好回应你"把研究问题写得尖锐但不过度夸张"的长期目标。你可以参考它如何用一个清晰的对立面（individual language competence vs. situated assemblage）来定位自己的贡献，同时将多模态会话分析作为evidence chain呈现发现，而非停留在经验描述。

relevance: 这篇论文与你今日主线"Chinese-English translanguaging in digital third spaces and identity work"高度契合：同样聚焦华人移民群体在社交媒体上的跨语言实践，同样将多模态社会符号学与translanguaging理论对接，且同样关注数字平台如何成为超越课堂的语言实践空间。它为你的Xiaohongshu稿件提供了一个直接的"对话对象"——你可以在文献定位中指出，已有研究（如本文）主要考察儿童/家庭层面的数字跨语言实践，而你的研究则将视角推向成人学习者社区中translanguaging的不对称功能分类与身份建构，从而锐化你的贡献声明。

relevance: 这篇论文与你今日主线"Teacher vulnerability, dual language immersion, and institutional discourse"高度贴合——虽然语境不同（IBC工科院校 vs. 双语沉浸项目），但核心关切一致：教师在新自由主义制度话语中被结构性边缘化所产生的情感劳动与脆弱性，且同样涉及制度权力如何通过学科等级、语言地位差异转化为教师个体的情感负担。

title: Understanding the Emotional Labor of English Language Teaching while Black in the United States
author: Malik Stevenson

relevance: 这篇论文直接贴合今日主线"Teacher vulnerability, dual language immersion, and institutional discourse"的核心关切——教师在制度性情感规则（emotional rules）下的脆弱性与身份挣扎，只是情境从双语沉浸转向了IEP中的种族化体验。它对你当前草稿最有借鉴价值的不是理论框架本身（emotional labor已是成熟概念），而是如何把高度个人化的自传民族志经历转化为制度层面的结构性分析——即作者怎样让"个人故事"服务于对institutional emotional rules这一权力机制的批判，而非停留在叙事共鸣层面，这恰好对应你今天最需要强化的写作能力。具体而言，值得关注作者在编码与证据呈现上如何将个人情感事件（race-related stress）系统性地连接到雇主/机构的情感规范，从而使"vulnerability"成为一个可分析的结构位置而非仅仅是一种感受描述。

relevance: 这篇论文与你今日的研究主线（teacher vulnerability, dual language immersion, institutional discourse）以及更广泛的应用语言学与批判话语研究几乎没有实质关联。它聚焦于元宇宙的技术分类体系（深度学习模型、虚拟货币、数字孪生等），既不涉及语言教育政策、教师身份与制度话语，也不提供可迁移的理论框架或方法论资源。唯一可能的远端联系是其对"线上与线下自我不可分割"这一Generation Z社会价值观的提及，但该论文并未从话语分析或身份建构角度展开，因此对你当前需要强化的"把个人经历转化为结构分析"的写作能力也无借鉴价值。

title: Bringing Race Into Second Language Acquisition
author: Nelson Flores, Jonathan Rosa
abstract: RECENTLY, SEVERAL NEWS ARTICLES WERE published celebrating the bilingualism of Princess Charlotte, the young daughter of Prince William and Catherine Middleton. A headline from Independent noted, “Princess Charlotte is already bilingual at age two,” with the author insisting that this was “a skill most people cannot claim” and that she “can't help but feel inferior” (Ritschel, 2018). title: Examining the Relationship Between Grit and Foreign Language Performance: Enjoyment and Anxiety as Mediators
author: Eerdemutu Liu, Junju Wang
abstract: The relationship between grit and success has been investigated extensively in various contexts. However, the association between grit and language performance, especially in a Chinese high school context, remains underexplored. title: “I think I am bilingual, but…”: Teachers’ practices of and student’ attitudes toward translanguaging in a Chinese intercultural communication class
author: Wang Zhi-jie, Bin Shen
abstract: Abstract Translanguaging encourages active and integrated usage of varied languages and other resources and exploitation of students’ whole linguistic repertories and cultural resources in teaching and learning. Zooming into an intercultural communication class in an English‐as‐a‐medium‐of‐instruction (EMI) fashion, the present study intends to discuss the teacher's pedagogical translanguaging pra…
relevance: 这篇论文与你今日主线"Translanguaging, identity negotiation, and action research in EMI classrooms"高度贴合：它同样聚焦中国高校EMI课堂中的教师教学性translanguaging实践，并将学生态度纳入分析，与你稿件中探讨学生身份协商和translanguaging感知的维度直接对话，可作为你定位研究贡献时的"已有研究"参照点——你需要说清楚自己的稿件在哪里超越了这类"实践描述＋态度调查"的框架。

title: Enactment of English medium instruction in under-resourced educational contexts: A case of multilingual public secondary schools in Nepal
author: Tae-Hee Choi, Prem Prasad Poudel
abstract: English as a medium of instruction (EMI) policy has shown substantial growth in all levels of education, driven by diverse aspirations such as raising individuals’ global competitiveness and internationalization of education. relevance: 这篇论文与你今日主线"Translanguaging, identity negotiation, and action research in EMI classrooms"在EMI政策与课堂实践的张力这一层面直接相关，尤其是它从"enacted policy"视角考察官方多语政策与实际EMI实践之间的落差，能为你的稿件提供一个对照性的制度背景论证——你的研究聚焦教师如何通过translanguaging在EMI课堂中协商身份，而这篇文章则揭示EMI在资源匮乏环境中被执行时的结构性矛盾，两者共同指向EMI并非单一的语言选择而是权力与资源分配的场域。

title: The interplay of language teachers’ identity, cognition, emotion, and agency, and the role of context: A scoping review
author: Khoa Dang Truong, Ngo Cong‐Lem, Bingqing Li
abstract: This scoping review explores complex interactions among identity, cognition, emotion, and agency in language teachers' socio-professional lives. relevance: 这篇scoping review聚焦语言教师身份、认知、情感与能动性之间的交互作用，与你今日主线"EMI课堂中translanguaging与身份协商"直接相关——尤其是你的行动研究稿件需要论证教师如何在反思性实践中重新协商自身身份并推动教学变革，这篇文章提供的"身份—能动性—情感—认知"交互框架及其多层语境因素的分析逻辑，恰好可以帮你把教师行动研究中的课堂发现从个人经验叙述提升为有理论锚定的论证。

title: Novice language teacher identity construction: similarities, differences, and beyond
author: Mostafa Nazari, Peter I. De Costa, Sedigheh Karimpour
abstract: Abstract Scholarship on novice language teachers has often overlooked how novices comparatively develop personalized trajectories in the initial years. title: Emotions, perspectives, and English language teacher identity construction: A phenomenographic‐narrative study
author: Mostafa Nazari, Sedigheh Karimpour
abstract: Abstract Despite the recent surge of interest in language teacher emotions, little research has examined the role of cognitive and social dimensions of teachers’ emotions in their identity construction. relevance: 这篇论文直接对应你今日主线"teacher identity, institutional discourse, and emotion"的核心交叉点——它明确将教师情绪的认知-社会维度与身份建构关联起来，而非将情绪停留在个人经验层面，这与你"Teacher Vulnerability / DLI"稿件中需要处理的"教师制度处境如何经由情绪塑造身份"议题高度吻合。

title: Differential impacts of e-portfolio assessment on language learners’ engagement modes and genre-based writing improvement
author: Natasha Pourdana, Kobra Tavassoli
abstract: Abstract Portfolio assessment (PA) as an assessment for learning (AfL) alternative has been under-represented in second/foreign language acquisition (SLA) research literature. This study examined the potential impacts of electronic PA (e-PA) on English-as-a-Foreign-Language (EFL) learners’ engagement modes in descriptive and narrative genres of writing on Moodle™. title: Enhancing academic writing skills and motivation: assessing the efficacy of ChatGPT in AI-assisted language learning for EFL students
author: Cuiping Song, Yanping Song
abstract: Introduction: This mixed-methods study evaluates the impact of AI-assisted language learning on Chinese English as a Foreign Language (EFL) students' writing skills and writing motivation. relevance: 这篇论文与你今日"academic writing, feedback, and revision"的扫描主线直接相关，聚焦AI辅助写作反馈对EFL学生写作技能与动机的影响，且采用中国EFL学生为被试，与你多篇稿件的研究情境（中文/英语学习者、语言教育政策）有背景层面的重叠。

author: Pramod K. Sah, Fan Fang
abstract: Abstract Many societies in the Global South have adopted English‐medium instruction (EMI) policies, but often ignoring—whether by design or involuntarily—the damages caused by the colonial legacy inherent in EMI. relevance: 这篇论文与你今日主线"Translanguaging, identity negotiation, and action research in EMI classrooms"在理论批判层直接相关：它为EMI研究提供了一个decolonial lens，而你的稿件正需要在理论框架部分说明translanguaging为何不仅是教学策略、更是对EMI内嵌权力结构的回应——这篇文章的问题意识可以帮你把"为什么在中国EMI语法课堂做translanguaging具有变革意义"这一论证锚点写得更尖锐，避免把translanguaging仅仅框定为课堂便利工具。

title: Why linguistic entrepreneurship?
author: Peter I. De Costa, Joseph Sung‐Yul Park, Lionel Wee
abstract: Abstract This introduction builds on De Costa et al.’s (2016], [2019) notion of linguistic entrepreneurship, which is defined as “the act of aligning with the moral imperative to strategically exploit language-related resources for enhancing one’s worth in the world” (2016: 696). The four empirical studies and two critical commentaries that constitute this special issue explain the relevance of th…
relevance: 这篇论文与你今日主线"Translanguaging, identity negotiation, and action research in EMI classrooms"在理论概念层有明确关联：linguistic entrepreneurship 关注学习者如何策略性地调动语言资源以提升自身价值，这与你稿件中学生在EMI课堂通过translanguaging进行身份协商的论证逻辑高度呼应——两者共享"语言实践作为能动性资源"这一理论内核，可以帮助你在讨论部分为学生的translanguaging行为赋予更精确的理论命名（如将其定位为一种linguistic entrepreneurship的表现形式），从而让论证超越"学生使用了translanguaging且觉得有用"的经验总结。

title: Artificial intelligence-based language learning: illuminating the impact on speaking skills and self-regulation in Chinese EFL context

relevance: 这篇论文与你今日"language assessment, fairness, and validity"主线高度相关，同时也直接呼应你AP Chinese / LAQ稿件中对考生如何理解与应对大规模写作评估的关注——它将assessment literacy的研究主体从教师/管理者翻转到考生端，并借助netnography捕捉考生在数字平台上围绕Duolingo English Test写作任务所形成的认知与策略，这与你Beyond Deficit / Xiaohongshu稿件中数字平台上用户话语实践的方法路径形成可类比的对话。

title: Interconnection between constructs and consequences: a key validity consideration in K–12 English language proficiency assessments
author: Mikyung Kim Wolf
abstract: Abstract In the US K–12 public school settings, each state’s annual English language proficiency (ELP) assessment, as part of an educational accountability system, has tremendous impact on English learner (EL) students’ academic paths and success. relevance: 这篇论文直接对应你今日主线"language assessment, fairness, and validity"，且聚焦于K–12 ELP评估的construct定义与consequences之间的内在关联——这与你AP Chinese/LAQ稿件中需要处理的"construct界定如何牵动公平性后果"议题高度吻合。最值得借鉴的是它的问题意识搭建方式：作为perspective piece，它不做大规模实证，而是通过将construct与consequences这两个通常被分开讨论的validity维度显性地"interconnect"起来，把一个看似技术性的效度问题重新框定为关乎EL学生学业命运的政策公平问题——这种"把两个已知概念之间的断裂本身定义为研究gap"的写法，正是你当前需要强化的"尖锐但不夸张"的问题意识表达策略。

title: Classroom-based language assessment literacy and professional development need between novice and experienced EFL teachers

title: The (white) ears of Ofsted: A raciolinguistic perspective on the listening practices of the schools inspectorate

abstract: Abstract England has had a schools inspectorate since 1839, first in the form of Her Majesty's Inspectorate (HMI), and since 1992, in the form of the Office for Standards in Education, Children's Services and Skills (Ofsted). relevance: 这篇论文直接对应你今日"language policy, ideology, and critical discourse"主线，并且与你"Teacher Vulnerability / DLI"及"Beyond Deficit"两条稿件高度共振——它聚焦的是一个制度性评估机构（Ofsted）如何通过听觉实践将种族化的语言意识形态嵌入学校督导报告，从而对教师与学生的口语表现施加规训权力，这与你关注的评估文件分配权力、教师制度处境以及deficit话语的运作逻辑一脉相通。

title: Prejudice Reduction: Progress and Challenges

title: Towards a Comprehensive, Empirical Model of Language Assessment Literacy across Stakeholder Groups: Developing the Language Assessment Literacy Survey

abstract: While scholars have proposed different models of language assessment literacy (LAL), these models have mostly comprised prescribed sets of components based on principles of good practice. title: From intercultural to transcultural communication
author: Will Baker
